## About
Capri Poker Room sits on Bay Area Blvd in Webster, and the doors are open around the clock. We run No Limit Texas Hold'em, Pot-Limit Omaha and a round of each, plus our own in-house tournaments. Whether you've played for years or you're just starting out, there's a game here for your level.
We want you comfortable while you play. The room is non-smoking, the seats are comfortable, and our servers bring food and cocktails to your table so you don't have to leave the action. If you need a break, there's on-site massage.
Regulars earn comp points for every game they play, which can go toward food, drinks and other perks. Call ahead to get on the list, and we'll seat you when a spot opens up.

## Services
- Cash games: A range of stakes and formats to choose from.
- Texas Hold'em and Omaha: The popular games, plus other variants.
- No Limit Texas Hold'em: Our no limit Hold'em game.
- PLO and No Limit Hold'em combination: A mix of Pot-Limit Omaha and No Limit Hold'em at the same table.
- In house tournaments: Tournaments run right here at Capri.
- High-hand jackpots: Regular high-hand jackpots and special promotions for players at the tables.
- Food tableside: Snacks and entrees ordered from your seat.
- Cocktail service: Servers bring your drinks right to your table.
- On-site massage: Take a break from the game and get a massage without leaving the building.
- Comp program: Earn points as you play and redeem them for food, drinks and other perks.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Every day, around the clock.

Q: Can I get on the list before I show up?
A: Yes. Give us a call and we'll add your name, so you get a seat as soon as one opens.

Q: Is the room non-smoking?
A: Yes. Capri Poker Room is non-smoking.

Q: Where do I park?
A: We offer valet parking. Just pull up and we'll handle the rest.

Q: Do you have Wi-Fi?
A: Yes, Wi-Fi is free for players.

## What customers say
- "First time here and I’m definitely coming back. I planned to stay about four hours and somehow ended up there for over eight. That pretty much says it all.

I was really impressed with the promotions and the whole food and drink system. It’s honestly one of the best setups I’ve seen at any poker room, and the food is actually really good, not just “good for a poker room.”

The dealers were awesome. They kept the action moving, joked around, and were patient and helpful with newer players. There was never a dull stretch at the table.

The games had great action and everyone was respectful toward each other, which made it even better.

I also met the owner and he’s genuinely a good guy. He took the time to learn players’ names and made sure we were taken care of. Easily the best customer experience I’ve had in a gambling setting.

Overall just an awesome experience. This is going to be my new go to spot." (Marc McGuire, 5/5)
